title: Colonization RE
subtitle: Documentation
description: How Sid Meier's Colonization really works, read out of the game's own code: player guides, file formats and the differences between versions.

sections.title: Player guides
sections.blurb: How the game works, with the exact numbers: terrain, units, Europe, taxes, the natives, combat, Founding Fathers and difficulty.

sections.title: Windows file formats
sections.blurb: Every file of the 1995 Windows release, byte by byte: the NE container, sprites, canvases, colour tables, text, maps and saves.

sections.title: DOS file formats
sections.blurb: The 1994 DOS release's MADSPACK archives, FAB compression, sprite sheets, pictures, fonts, palettes, maps and saves.

sections.title: Version differences
sections.blurb: What changed between the DOS, Windows and Macintosh releases, and what stayed the same.
